subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule tech deep dive

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule tech deep dive

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — really helpful to understand Acme Analytics' goals around faster query summarization and auditability for customer-facing insights.

Quick recap / priorities we heard:
- Need low-latency summarization for near-real-time dashboards (p95 < 500ms per request)
- Strong audit logs and retention controls (SOC 2 + region-based data residency)
- Expected traffic: ~2M inference tokens/day initially, seasonal spikes up to ~8M

Next step: technical deep dive to align on architecture, SSO/KMS, and implementation plan. Are you available for a 60-minute session on either:
- Tue, Apr 27 — 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET
- Wed, Apr 28 — 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET

Who from your side should join (engineering + security)? We'll include our Solutions Engineer (Marissa) and a product PM.

I can send a calendar invite with a Zoom link once you confirm a slot and attendee list. I also attached our product deck and a draft mutual action plan for the call.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | (650) 555-0192
